info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Tracks-v4-spec
info.description: The Track Deliveries API allows users to efficiently retrieve the status and updates of food delivery tracks. This endpoint serves as a vital resource for businesses in the food delivery sector, enabling them to monitor deliveries in real-time. Typical consumers include delivery personnel, operational teams, and customer service agents who rely on accurate tracking information to enhance service quality. By using this API, stakeholders can ensure timely updates and maintain communication with customers regarding delivery progress.

get.summary: Retrieve the tracking information for a delivery.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to track the current status and details of a specified delivery. By providing the necessary tracking identifier, users can obtain real-time updates and relevant information regarding their delivery's progress.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary parameters for tracking a delivery. Ensure that you specify the correct delivery ID and any other relevant tracking information in the request body.

200.description: Request completed successfully, delivery status retrieved.
